title: The Triangle of Yapping Framework
one_liner: A 3-part framework to structure talking-head videos that actually get views.
key_points: Start with T/T (Thought or Topic) — drop viewers into the middle of a conversation, skip the intro fluff
Add MAES (Metaphor, Analogy, Example, or Story) to make any boring topic engaging
End with A/N (Application or Next Steps) so viewers know exactly what to do after watching
Combining all three parts gives your videos a repeatable structure that drives retention and results
